title: Hormonal changes must be part of the conversation in neurological care
title_zh: 神经护理中必须讨论激素变化
abstract: Maya Uccheddu lives with myasthenia gravis and has experienced how hormonal changes can shape life with the disease. She highlights how menstruation, perimenopause and menopause remain under-discussed in neurological care and calls for hormonal life stages to be accounted for in research, clinical conversations and guidelines.
abstract_zh: Maya Uccheddu 患有重症肌无力，并经历过激素变化如何影响疾病生活。她强调月经、围绝经和绝经在神经护理中仍然讨论不足，并呼吁在研究、临床对话和指南中考虑激素生命阶段。
